channel.title: The Honolulu Star-Advertiser - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Honolulu Star-Advertiser (staradvertiser.com)

item.title: Anthony Kim wins LIV Adelaide after 12-year hiatus
item.description: Anthony Kim added a stunning yet true chapter to his storybook return to professional golf by winning LIV Golf Adelaide on Sunday (Saturday in Hawaii).

item.title: Obama laments lost decorum in first remarks since Trump video
item.description: Former President Barack Obama this weekend indirectly addressed a racist video posted this month by President Donald Trump, which depicted Obama and his wife, former first lady Michelle Obama, as apes.

item.title: Toyota’s Tyler Reddick wins thrilling Daytona 500
item.description: Tyler Reddick passed leader Chase Elliott off the final turn today to win the thrilling 68th annual Daytona 500 in Daytona Beach, Fla.

item.title: FBI: DNA recovered from glove found near Nancy Guthrie’s home
item.description: TUCSON, Arizona >> Investigators have obtained a DNA sample from a glove that was found near Nancy Guthrie’s Arizona home and appears to match the pair worn by a masked prowler seen in doorbell camera footage before she was abducted two weeks ago, the FBI said today.

item.title: Warner Bros. is said to mull reopening talks with Paramount
item.description: Warner Bros. Discovery is weighing whether to reopen deal talks with Paramount, which last week submitted a new, improved offer, said two people who are familiar with the matter but not authorized to speak publicly about it.

item.title: Episode 42 begins as Kilauea fountaining returns
item.description: Kilauea volcano roared back to life today as a new episode of lava fountaining began within the Halemaumau crater.

item.title: High surf hits east shores; ashfall advisory posted for Big Island
item.description: An ashfall advisory is in effect for Hawaii island after a new eruptive episode at Kilauea volcano began sending volcanic particles toward eastern and southeastern communities, as high surf and small craft advisories add to statewide hazards.

item.title: Man, 25, arrested after gunshot during Hawaii Kai argument
item.description: A 25-year-old man was arrested Sunday in Hawaii Kai on suspicion of first-degree terroristic threatening and reckless endangering after he allegedly fired a handgun during an argument, according to the Honolulu Police Department.

item.title: HFD airlifts injured dirt biker near Whitmore Village
item.description: An injured dirt biker in his 40s was rescued by air Sunday morning near Whitmore Village in Wahiawa after he was unable to make his way down a trail, according to the Honolulu Fire Department.

item.title: Gonzaga scores 5 runs in the 12th to beat Hawaii
item.description: Gonzaga scored five runs in the 12th inning to break away to a 7-2 baseball victory over Hawaii today at Les Murakami Stadium.
